The record is checked live against the issuing authority each epoch, and a revoked or missing entry loses the seat. The canyon signal separates the two cases at a glance: A farm faking 481 aliases needs 481 separate verifiable records of this kind, each checked against the issuing authority, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The ferrous ledger records each payment, the anchor window resets the board, and 481 fakes never beat one honest agent on price.
